integrity.proof_scope: Finite b-ary trees, q>=3, b>=2, h>=1 and fixed-b,q depth limits.

scientific_limitations: Condition number concerns the nonconstant all-vertex first Fourier band; the constant eigenvalue is provided but excluded from this ratio.
No nonlinear reconstruction, leaf-only sampling or joint growth of branching/alphabet are claimed.
The general tree exponential-distance inverse and classical Kesten-Stigum threshold predate this work; equivalent historical spectral formulations remain a possibility.
Analytic all-parameter argument supported, not replaced, by finite numerical checks.
title: A sharp three-regime Fourier conditioning law for uniformly proper-coloured regular trees
